reviews.text: The Samsung Galaxy Book3 looks sleek and the 15.6-inch FHD+ display is incredibly bright for outdoor work. I am impressed by the Intel Core i5 performance which handles multitasking smoothly without any lag. However, the battery life is quite disappointing as it barely lasts four hours with heavy usage. The keyboard feels decent to type on, though the trackpad could be slightly more responsive. Overall, it is a solid mid-range laptop that offers good value for the price point.

The Samsung Galaxy Book3 has a stunning 15.6-inch display with vibrant colors that make watching movies a joy. I am impressed by the Intel Core i5 processor which handles multitasking smoothly without any lag. The battery life is decent for light work but drains quickly when running heavy applications. For the price, the build quality feels a bit plasticky compared to other premium ultrabooks. Overall, it is a solid choice for students who need a reliable machine for daily tasks.

It features an Intel Core i5 processor which handles multitasking smoothly without any lag. The keyboard feels responsive and the trackpad is accurate for daily navigation. The Samsung Galaxy Book3 feels incredibly light and sleek, making it perfect for my daily commute. However, the 15.6-inch AMOLED display gets too bright for outdoor use, and the battery barely lasts four hours. With the 13th Gen Intel i5 processor, it handles multitasking smoothly without any noticeable lag. The keyboard typing experience is decent, though the trackpad feels a bit small compared to my old Mac. For the price of $799, I expected more storage space, but the included 512GB SSD is sufficient for basic tasks.

The Samsung Galaxy Book3 is a stunning laptop with a vibrant 15.6-inch display that looks perfect for creative work. While the 13th Gen Intel Core i7 CPU handles multitasking smoothly, the battery life is disappointing during heavy video editing. The keyboard feels responsive and comfortable for long typing sessions, though the trackpad is a bit smaller than I expected. At this price point, the build quality feels solid, but the lack of an SD card slot is a significant inconvenience for photographers. Overall, it is a capable machine that balances performance and portability well for students and professionals alike.

The Samsung Galaxy Book3 3 is a sleek machine with a stunning 1080p display that shines even in bright offices. At this price point, the lack of a fingerprint scanner and limited port selection feels like a missed opportunity for a premium laptop. Overall, it is a solid mid-range option for students who need portability and a good keyboard for typing essays.
